description.en: Xiaomi MiMo desktop app credential path: the account authorizes in the browser through the same key-minting flow MiMo Code uses, and the minted key talks OpenAI protocol on the gateway it was bound to (Token Plan credits or pay-as-you-go).
description.zh: 小米 MiMo 桌面 App 凭据通道：通过 MiMo Code 同款浏览器授权流铸造账号密钥，密钥在其绑定的网关上以 OpenAI 协议调用（Token Plan 订阅额度或按量计费）。

description.en: Opens the MiMo authorize page — sign in with the Xiaomi account and pick Use API Key or Use Token Plan, then paste the 授权码 the page shows. The key is minted for this connection only and unlocks the gateway it names.
description.zh: 打开 MiMo 授权页 — 用小米账号登录并选择“使用 API Key”或“使用 Token Plan”，再粘贴页面显示的授权码。密钥仅为本次连接铸造，只在其对应的网关上有效。
